purpose: Test whether a different model family can independently reconstruct the same source-level structural content from the original sources under a public frozen procedure.
not_equivalent_to: proof that the retained ClaimIR is uniquely correct
execution_contract: Use a model family distinct from the model family used for the retained reconstruction pipeline when feasible.
For each source, expose only the original source, this protocol, the frozen prompt, and the blank output schema.
Do not expose retained ClaimIR, bounded-object memberships, grammar verdicts, capacity-case outcomes, comparison answers, or prior model outputs before all ten new records are frozen.
Permit ABSTAIN or UNDERDETERMINED rather than forcing a reconstruction.
Record exact provider, model name/version, access date, decoding or sampling settings when available, context/tool settings, and whether web or file retrieval was used.
Save the raw model response verbatim before normalization.
Complete all ten records before opening the retained reference records for comparison.
After freeze, compare by the separately frozen comparison rules; do not tune the extraction prompt after seeing disagreement.
public_replay_contract: Any third party may replay the same packet with another model family.
A replay remains informative whether it agrees, disagrees, or abstains.
Agreement supports cross-model reproducibility of the extraction procedure under the tested models.
Disagreement identifies model- or judgment-sensitive fields and does not by itself establish that either output is false.
human_boundary: Cross-model replication is reported separately from human validation. Procedural auditability is established; inter-rater reliability remains unmeasured.
